summary:
AGROBIT is a smart agriculture web application developed to help farmers make data-driven decisions about crop selection, soil conditions, and sustainable farming.

The project was built using Python, FastAPI, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQLite, following a REST API architecture. The backend handles environmental data processing, crop suitability calculations, field management, and crop rotation recommendations, while the interactive frontend provides dashboards, satellite maps, and analytical reports.

AGROBIT integrates environmental data sources such as NASA POWER, MODIS, and SoilGrids to evaluate climate conditions, vegetation health, and soil properties. Its rule-based recommendation algorithm scores crop suitability and generates three-year crop rotation strategies.

By combining backend development, API integration, database management, and agricultural data analysis, AGROBIT addresses challenges such as inefficient crop selection, soil degradation, and limited access to agricultural insights.

Our goal is to make smart farming technologies more accessible and support sustainable, efficient agricultural decision-making.
details:
Project Overview

AGROBIT is a smart agriculture web application designed to help farmers make informed decisions about crop selection, soil conditions, and sustainable agricultural planning.

How It Works

Users register their agricultural fields by entering geographic coordinates, field size, and current crop. AGROBIT analyzes environmental information, including temperature, rainfall, vegetation indicators, and soil properties, using data sources such as NASA POWER, MODIS, and SoilGrids.

Our rule-based recommendation algorithm evaluates crop suitability and generates three-year crop rotation strategies. Users can compare different crops, visualize field locations on satellite maps, save rotation plans, and download analysis reports.

Technologies Used

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, REST APIs
  • Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Database: SQLite
  • Mapping: Leaflet.js and Esri Satellite Imagery
  • Data Integration: NASA POWER, MODIS, SoilGrids
  • Development Tools: Git, GitHub, Swagger/OpenAPI

Innovation and Benefits

AGROBIT combines environmental data analysis, crop recommendations, and multi-year crop rotation planning in one accessible platform.

Instead of presenting raw scientific data, the system transforms environmental indicators into understandable suitability scores and practical recommendations.

Challenges and Considerations

Our team considered climate variability, water requirements, soil health, crop diversity, accessibility, and the reliability of external data sources. We also implemented a demonstration mode to showcase the platform when external data services are unavailable.

Expected Impact

AGROBIT aims to help farmers make better planting decisions, support sustainable soil management, improve agricultural resource planning, and make satellite-based environmental insights more accessible.

Our long-term vision is to expand AGROBIT with machine learning, IoT sensors, and more advanced agricultural forecasting capabilities.
